notes.title: Back in the Cockpit, Pilots!
notes.content: We just pushed out a patch that should address compatibility issues some users experienced running X-Wing vs TIE Fighter on Windows 10. Now you can get back to dodging X-wings, and decimating TIE fighters!

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content: [*]Anti-virus programs no longer show a false positive and quarantine the game executable.  This also fixes the missing CD error message.
